compiled_state.title: dispatch.py: use LiteLLM fallbacks=[] and context_window_fallbacks=[] SDK parameters (DD1)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: every litellm.completion() call in dso_ci_review/dispatch.py is constructed with
  streaming=False, fallbacks=[...] rendered from ci_review.provider_chain, and
  context_window_fallbacks=[...] rendered from the agent's model upgraded through
  [haiku, sonnet, opus] on the agent's primary provider

## Context (from completion verifier DD1 FAIL)
Current implementation in dispatch.py manually iterates provider_chain in a Python loop
instead of passing LiteLLM's native fallbacks= and context_window_fallbacks= SDK parameters.
DD1 explicitly requires these parameters to be passed to litellm.completion(). Additionally,
config.py reads ci_review.provider (singular) not ci_review.provider_chain, so the config
key specified in DD1 is never read by the Python module.

## Implementation
1. Update dispatch_review() to use LiteLLM native SDK fallbacks:
   - Build fallbacks list: [{"model": "openai/<model>", ...}] for non-primary providers
   - Build context_window_fallbacks: haiku→sonnet→opus on primary provider
   - Pass both to litellm.completion(model=primary, messages=[...], stream=False,
     fallbacks=fallbacks, context_window_fallbacks=context_window_fallbacks)
   - Remove the manual provider_chain iteration loop
2. Update providers/config.py parse_provider_chain() OR add a new helper to read
   ci_review.provider_chain from .claude/dso-config.conf (the key ci_review.provider_chain
   now exists in the config file from Batch 1)
3. Update tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_fallback.py to assert the LiteLLM
   SDK parameters are passed (not that a manual loop occurs)

Files to modify:
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_fallback.py (UPDATE existing tests)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py && cd plugins/dso/scripts && poetry run pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/ -v 2>/dev/null | tail -20
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py
- [ ] litellm.completion calls pass fallbacks= parameter
  Verify: grep -q "fallbacks=" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py
- [ ] litellm.completion calls pass context_window_fallbacks= parameter
  Verify: grep -q "context_window_fallbacks=" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py
- [ ] stream=False preserved (not streaming=True)
  Verify: grep -q "stream=False" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py && ! grep -q "streaming=True" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py

## Pattern Reference
LiteLLM native fallbacks pattern (from LiteLLM docs):
  litellm.completion(
      model="anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5",
      messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "..."}],
      stream=False,
      fallbacks=[{"model": "openai/gpt-4o-mini"}, {"model": "openai/gpt-4o"}],
      context_window_fallbacks=[
          {"anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5": ["anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"]},
          {"anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022": ["anthropic/claude-opus-4-5"]},
      ]
  )
This pattern replaces the manual provider_chain iteration loop.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
